description: Create a NEW blank page in the project and (by default) select it. Returns the new page's id and fileName. The page starts nearly empty — fill it with `replace_page_content` or `add_section`, and point a navbar/link at it with `link_page`. Use THIS to add an additional page; use `replace_page_content` (NOT this) to overwrite the current page's content.

fileName.description: Optional URL slug without .html (e.g. 'about'). Defaults to a slug derived from `name`; auto-deduplicated against existing pages.

name.description: Display name / title for the page (e.g. 'About').

select.description: Select the new page after creating it. Default true.

name: swebsy_create_page
